storagefinder.index.save_failed: §cCould not save the storage index; the mod will retry
storagefinder.config.title: Storage Finder Settings
storagefinder.config.enabled.tooltip: Turns every Storage Finder feature on or off without losing the remembered index.
storagefinder.config.index_containers.to: Remember the contents of chests, barrels, shulker boxes and your ender chest whenever you open them, including items inside shulker boxes and bundles.
storagefinder.config.search_frames.toolt: Treat an item frame on a storage block as a label for its contents.
storagefinder.config.search_memory.toolt: Search the remembered contents of storage you opened before.
storagefinder.config.highlight.tooltip: Outline matching storage blocks in the search color.
storagefinder.config.route.tooltip: Draw walking routes from you to the nearest matching storage.
storagefinder.config.avoid_hazards.toolt: Keep routes away from fire, magma, cacti, berry bushes, powder snow and dripstone.
storagefinder.config.messages.tooltip: Show short action-bar messages when searches or the index change.
storagefinder.config.radius_hint: The radius is capped at eight chunks
storagefinder.config.hotkey_hint: Configure the search key in Controls; an empty hand opens text search
storagefinder.config.reset_value: Click to restore the default value
storagefinder.config.defaults.tooltip: Restore every default here; nothing is written until you press Save.
storagefinder.config.cancel.tooltip: Close and discard the changes on these screens.
storagefinder.config.unsaved: Unsaved changes: press Save to apply them
storagefinder.config.unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
storagefinder.config.unsaved.message: Storage Finder settings were changed but not saved. Discard them, or keep editing and press Save.
storagefinder.config.sub_screen_hint: Changes apply after you press Save on the main settings screen
storagefinder.config.saved.title: Storage Finder
storagefinder.config.save_failed.title: Save failed
storagefinder.config.save_failed.descrip: Settings were not written; try again
storagefinder.search.title: Search Storage by Item
storagefinder.search.description: Search by name in the current language or by item ID
storagefinder.search.hint: Name, ID or #tag, for example oak_log…
storagefinder.search.no_results: Nothing matches "%s". Try another name or an item ID such as oak_log.
storagefinder.search.empty_catalog: Type an item name or ID. Items from storage you have already opened appear here first.
storagefinder.search.footer: %s results • Click or Enter: toggle search • Right-click or Shift+Enter: pin
storagefinder.statistics.title: Storage Statistics
storagefinder.statistics.description_eve: Latest known contents of all indexed storage in this dimension
storagefinder.statistics.empty: No data — open storage within this radius first
storagefinder.statistics.no_matches: Nothing matches this filter. Clear the search field to see every item.
storagefinder.statistics.click_hint: • Click an item to toggle its search
storagefinder.route_failure.no_reachable: no reachable side of the storage
storagefinder.index_manager.title: Storage Index
storagefinder.index_manager.export.toolt: Write a copy of the whole index to the storage_finder_exports folder.
storagefinder.index_manager.delete.toolt: Forget the selected storage (Delete key). It is remembered again the next time you open it.
storagefinder.index_manager.empty: No indexed storage in this view
storagefinder.index_manager.no_matches: No records match this filter. Search by coordinates such as 120 64 -35.
storagefinder.hud_config.title: Storage Finder HUD
storagefinder.hud_config.compact.tooltip: One line per search: name and distance only.
storagefinder.hud_config.distance.toolti: Show the walking distance of the shortest route, or the straight-line distance while routing.
storagefinder.hud_config.freshness.toolt: Warn when results rely on old snapshots or item frames only.
storagefinder.hud_layout.title: Place the Storage Finder HUD
storagefinder.hud_layout.description: Drag the preview; the nearest corner becomes its anchor
storagefinder.hud_layout.keyboard_hint: Arrow keys move it by 1 pixel, Shift+arrows by 8
storagefinder.route_config.title: Storage Finder Routes
storagefinder.route_config.swimming.tool: Allow routes through water; swimming uses the real swimming hitbox.
storagefinder.route_config.doors.tooltip: Wooden doors and fence gates count as passable; iron doors never do.
storagefinder.route_config.geometry_hint: Slabs, stairs, carpets, snow, ladders and water use their real geometry.
storagefinder.route_config.movement_hint: Routes may step down up to three blocks, which is the fall height that deals no damage.
storagefinder.route_config.budget_hint: A larger budget finishes sooner but spends more client time per tick.
storagefinder.config.shulker_preview.too: Holding Shift shows a shulker box tooltip as inventory slots. Empty boxes keep the Quick Recipe Viewer recipe.
storagefinder.config.completion.tooltip: "When taken" ends a search only after you take the item out. "When opened" ends it as soon as you open a storage that has it. "Never" keeps it until you remove it.
storagefinder.search.group: Everything matching "%s" — %s items, plus renamed ones
storagefinder.search.tag_unknown: Tag %s was not found. Try #minecraft:logs or #wool.
storagefinder.index_manager.route.toolti: Highlight this storage and route to it (double-click or Enter). Press again to remove the route.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.storagefinder: Find storage from item frames and remembered contents
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.storagefi: Colored highlights and safe routes to storage for selected item types.
